status: fifteen card candidates plus one v0.6.3 retirement under design, wording, and balance review

cards.name: Phantom Passage
cards.design_status: mechanic and title locked; cost provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Put this card in your Graveyard. Move to any Territory you control.

language_review: Omitted affirmative battle-start permission because effect-granted movement may create a pending battle by shared rule.

cards.name: Battlefield Plunder
cards.design_status: mechanic and title locked; cost provisional

effects.label: Gambit/Tactic
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you win, place this Overlay on the contested Territory.

effects.label: Overlay
effects.text: At the start of a player's Opening while they are here, that player may put this card in its owner's Discard Pile. If they do, +2 Cards.

language_review: Uses place this Overlay rather than place this card as an Overlay.
Uses +2 Cards shorthand because the acting player and destination are unambiguous.

cards.name: High Command
cards.design_status: accepted concept; exact cost and restriction provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card. You may have only one banked High Command.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: Your maximum Command is 3.

language_review: Retains a printed banking Action because the maximum-one-banked restriction is a special banking procedure.

cards.name: War Witch
cards.design_status: mechanic, wording direction, and title locked; cost provisional

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: When choosing Tactics, you may put this card in your Graveyard. If you do, +1 Tactic from your Graveyard. In the Aftermath, put that card in your Graveyard.

language_review: Omitted the redundant Bank Action because Asset cards have an inherent banking Action.
Uses +1 Tactic from your Graveyard; shared additional-Tactic rules supply eligibility and timing.

cards.name: Plenipotentiary
cards.design_status: accepted prototype direction; Influence curve remains a balance test

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: After the opponent refuses an unratified Proposal, you may put this card in your Graveyard and spend Influence equal to the number of Proposals you would then have ratified. If you do, ratify that Proposal. Gain no Influence for ratifying it this way. Its Refused effect still applies.

effects.label: Gambit
effects.text: If this battle follows refused Terms, apply the Refused effect of one other ratified Proposal whose requirement is met.

language_review: Removed the redundant Bank Action because this Asset has no special banking procedure.
Retains Gambit-only eligibility rather than broadening to Gambit/Tactic.

cards.name: Diplomatic Divination
cards.design_status: mechanic and title locked; cost provisional

effects.label: Terms
effects.text: When you offer Terms, before the opponent accepts or refuses, you may reveal this card from your Hand, name accept or refuse, and set it aside. After the opponent chooses, if you named that choice, +1 Influence and put this card in your Discard Pile. Otherwise, put it in your Graveyard.

language_review: Uses the established Terms timing template and +1 Influence shorthand.

cards.name: War Bonds
cards.design_status: accepted concept; exact cost and restriction provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card. You may have only one banked War Bonds.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: After the first battle each turn, you may place one card from your Hand face up in your Treasury. If you do, +1 Capital.

language_review: Retains a printed banking Action because the maximum-one-banked restriction is a special banking procedure.
Uses +1 Capital shorthand.

cards.name: Actuarial Alchemy
cards.design_status: mechanic and title locked; cost provisional

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: In the Aftermath, if you lost, you may put this card in your Graveyard. If you do, gain Capital equal to the amount by which your opponent's Battle Total or Tiebreak Roll exceeded yours.

language_review: Removed the redundant Bank Action because Asset cards have an inherent banking Action.
Preserves actual Battle Total or Tiebreak Roll margin and gives no payout for a Defensive Edge-only loss.

cards.name: Regime Change
cards.design_status: accepted concept; exact cost and uniqueness/restriction provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card. You may have only one banked Regime Change.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: The opponent cannot use their Leader abilities.

language_review: Retains a printed banking Action because the maximum-one-banked restriction is a special banking procedure.

cards.name: Spectral Surveillance
cards.design_status: mechanic, title, and OR capitalization locked; cost provisional

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: When you use Surveillance, you may put this card in your Graveyard instead of spending Intel. If you do, reveal all opposing Gambits OR Tactics chosen for that battle.

language_review: Removed the redundant Bank Action because Asset cards have an inherent banking Action.
The replacement explicitly removes the entire Surveillance Intel cost, including the first reveal.

cards.name: Reembodiment
cards.design_status: mechanic and title locked; recursion details and cost provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card. You may have only one banked copy.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: The first time each turn you put an Arcane card from your Hand in your Graveyard as a cost or part of an effect you control, after that effect resolves, you may return one other lower-value card from your Graveyard to your Hand.

language_review: Marks the card Arcane to preserve the rule that Mystics cards are Arcane.
Retains a printed banking Action because the maximum-one-banked restriction is a special banking procedure.

cards.name: Threefold Vision
cards.design_status: mechanic and title locked; cost provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Look at the top three cards of your Draw Pile. Put one in your Hand, one in your Discard Pile, and one in your Graveyard.

language_review: Uses the current Draw Pile, Hand, Discard Pile, and Graveyard zone names.

cards.name: Retribution
cards.design_status: accepted leading direction; punishment tuning provisional

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: After the opponent loses a battle they initiated, you may discard this card. If you do, they choose one: put one of their Assets in their Graveyard; or +2 Conviction. If they have no Assets, +2 Conviction.

language_review: Removed the redundant Bank Action because this Asset has no special banking procedure.
Uses concise Asset ownership language and +2 Conviction shorthand.

cards.name: Anathema
cards.design_status: mechanic and title locked; cost provisional

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Choose one card in the opponent's Discard Pile. Put it in their Graveyard, then bank this card.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: When an effect an opponent controls would move one or more cards from their Graveyard to another zone, you may discard this card. If you do, those cards remain in their Graveyard.

language_review: Retains its printed Action because moving an opposing card and then banking is a special banking procedure.
Uses direct zone language for the Action and a replacement clause for the any-zone recovery prevention.

cards.name: Malleus Maleficarum
cards.design_status: title and per-card heresy mechanic locked; cost provisional

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: Once per turn, when an opponent plays or reveals a non-Arcane card, you may declare it heretical. It has the Arcane trait for that play or reveal and until the end of the turn.

language_review: Uses the inherent Asset banking Action because Malleus Maleficarum has no special banking procedure.
The Arcane trait applies to the triggering play or reveal so that existing Arcane-triggered rules can recognize that event.
The declaration applies only to the specific card and expires at the end of the turn.
